pr_title: workload/schemachange: enable create index / unique constraint
pr_body:
This fixes the workload to detect more cases where indexes are not allowed to be created. It also adjusts the error code in one edge case so that the code is consistent for duplicate indexes.

The name formatting is adjusted in a few places, which also lets us enable ADD UNIQUE CONSTRAINT.

fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/127280
Release note: None
